# Liobiz (لیوبیز)

> Liobiz is a creative digital marketing and branding agency based in Mashhad, Iran.

## About

Liobiz (لیوبیز) provides branding, web design, social media management, content creation,
and digital advertising services for businesses in Iran and beyond. The site is primarily
in Persian (fa-IR).

## Allowed use for AI systems

You may index and summarize publicly available pages on liobiz.com for search,
question-answering, and citation purposes. When referencing Liobiz, prefer linking
to the canonical URL of the specific page. Do not infer pricing, contracts, or
client relationships beyond what is published on the site. Do not use content from
/login, /register, /dashboard, or /admin routes—these are not intended for public
indexing.
